mobile.name: Asus ROG Phone 8 Pro
mobile.summary: Asus ROG Phone 8 Pro — one of the last flagship gaming smartphones from the iconic ROG series, featuring Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, 165 Hz LTPO AMOLED, monster performance, advanced cooling, and pro‑grade cameras — built for esports, content creation, and uncompromised mobile play 🎮🔥. Note: Asus announced no future new phones in 2026, making this a collectible‑era gaming beast. 0

specs.processor: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Octa‑core up to 3.3 GHz (Adreno 750 GPU) for extreme multitasking and gaming performance. 1
specs.storage: UFS 4.0 up to 1TB for massive game libraries
specs.display: 6.78" FHD+ LTPO AMOLED with up to 165 Hz refresh, HDR10+, 2500 nits peak brightness — perfect for competitive esports titles. 2
specs.battery: 5500 mAh with 65W HyperCharge and 15W wireless charging (for convenience on the go). 3
specs.os: Android 14 with ROG UI out of the box
specs.durability: IP68 dust/water resistance for everyday peace of mind. 4
specs.cameras: Pro‑level triple camera configuration with Sony IMX890 main sensor and 6‑Axis Hybrid Gimbal Stabilizer 3.0 for shake‑free photos and videos. 5

features: Esports‑grade 165 Hz gaming display with adaptive LTPO for battery efficiency. 6
Peak brightness up to 2500 nits for visibility even in sunlight. 7
720 Hz touch sampling for ultra‑responsive gaming controls. 8
Robust cooling system and optional AeroActive accessories on older models (still useful).
Pro audio with Dirac‑tuned stereo and spatial sound for immersive gameplay. 9
mobile.notes: Asus announced in early 2026 that it would halt new smartphone production, making existing ROG Phone models like the 8 Pro some of the last widely available gaming‑focused Android devices from the brand. 10
